non_claims: This injects already world-frame messages to isolate Coordinator behavior; it does not test camera calibration, vision, or coordinate-transform accuracy.
The 1 mm disagreement is a deterministic malformed-message example, not a measurement-noise tolerance or an adopted threshold.
No robot, MuJoCo dynamics, IK, collision, grasp, planner, safety system, or hardware execution is used.
pass_conditions: all 25 consistent two-frame coordinate pairs are accepted
for each B, a second-camera coordinate offset by the declared nonzero example offset rejects before mock execution and leaves A unchanged
for each B, a second-camera scenario-version mismatch rejects before mock execution and leaves A unchanged
